paragraphs: Pawlytics sells animal rescue software for foster based animal rescues and animal shelters. The product centralizes a group's pet and people records in one database. Custom forms and applications can be embedded into an organization's website, and completed applications arrive in the same database. Adoptable pet listings can be exported automatically to third party websites such as Petfinder, Adopt-A-Pet and Shelter Animals Count.

Adoptions can be processed electronically, and completed contracts are stored with the pet record. A matching feature named FosterFix is described as identifying available foster homes in a rescue or region and pairing them with pets. The software is sold in modules so that a non-profit pays only for what it needs. New users can start with a 14 day free trial.
The about page credits Lizz Whitacre, who ran her own rescue and found the record keeping and paperwork overwhelming. Pawlytics is a registered Public Benefit Corporation.

quote.text: Designed to suit the needs of animal rescue organizations of all sizes and forms through affordable pricing and features built to grow with your needs.
